notes.title: #3 Develop Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the beating heart of power, where decisions change the fortunes of companies and laws shape economic destiny. In the Policy section of Hedge Fund Tycoon, you hold the reins of government, facing the complex world of politics and strategic alliances.

Parties
In the game, there are four types of parties, each with a unique political philosophy. Each party has a preference for a certain type of company, giving it an advantage over the others. The types of parties present are:


 Right: it is for the abatement of taxes and public spending. It therefore favours companies that do not have the possibility to win contracts and companies that operate in those sectors affected by specific taxes (car tax for the automotive).
 Left: Supports increased public spending and taxes to fuel welfare policies. It mainly favours companies dependent on public procurement (defence, infrastructure,...)
 Center: its policies are placed halfway between those of the right and the left, public expenditure and taxes at medium levels.
 Technical or military: this type of party comes to power only in exceptional cases such as coups d'etat or financial default. Given the emergency situation these parties are facing, they will disadvantage all kinds of companies. They will raise taxes and minimise public procurement.

Taxes, Laws and Corruption
Each nation has taxes and laws that affect the profitability of companies operating in the country.
Taxes:

 Corporate tax: applies to all sectors
 Car tax: applies to the automotive sector
 Internet tax: applies to the Media and Internet service sectors
 Carbon tax: applies to the Oil & Drilling and Airlines sectors

Laws:

 Martial law: if active, elections are no longer called

Corruption: Each Hedge Fund will have the opportunity to bribe the government to change the value of a tax or law. The amount of the bribe will depend on the strength of the pro-change party in parliament and the importance of the law. Obviously, if the judicial authorities discover the corruptive scheme, the penalties will be heavy.

Elections: Popularity and Funding
The popularity of the party is crucial to winning the election. Political decisions, laws and taxes will affect public perception.However, fundraising is essential to conducting effective election campaigns. Some parties can obtain funding more easily based on links with certain Hedge Funds. You too, as the owner of your investment fund, can interfere in national policy to benefit the companies in your portfolio.

Revolutions and Coups of State
Dissatisfied popularity: In the most politically and economically unstable countries, there may be a risk of riots or coups. Factions led by dissatisfied parties may try to overthrow the current government. If this were to happen in Hedge Fund Tycoon, the winning party would gain complete control of the parliament.

Procurement
There are sectors that can participate in tenders launched by different nations. The contract is a temporary contract by which a nation pays a company to provide its services. Each contract will then have a deadline, a reference sector and an annual value that will be transferred to the winning company. All companies in the procurement sector may participate in the tender. The factors taken into account during the evaluation to award the contract are:

 Local business
 Company has a branch in the country
 Quality
 Government opinion on the Hedge Fund controller
 Ability CLO
 Not likely to Bankrupt
 Quantity of Contracts already won (The more they have the less likely to get more)


Get ready for a realistic and engaging experience in the world of finance and trading. Stay tuned for more details on the game launch!

notes.title: #2 Develop Update
notes.content:
Hi aspiring greedy capitalists,

as promised, here is a deepening of the dynamics of Hedge Fund Tycoon.
In this new simulator, players will have the opportunity to trade a wide range of financial products, including:

1. Stock shares: You will be able to invest in shares in listed companies. If applicable, the shares are entitled to a quarterly dividend; the share paid to the shareholders is decided by the CEO or the control fund. Holding at least 20% of the share capital and if the fund turns out to be the majority shareholder you will have the opportunity to manage and control the company.

2. Corporate bonds: Bonds are a safer alternative to shares. Bonds are debt securities at the maturity of which the nominal value invested and the regular interest will be obtained throughout the holding period. The coupon is quarterly.

3. Government bonds: You can invest in government bonds, giving you a safe choice for managing your portfolio. The coupon is variable and depends on the rating, the duration can be 10 or 20 years.

4. Commodities: You will have the opportunity to trade commodities such as oil, gold and other physical goods, as a result of price fluctuations on the commodity market. No periodic returns accumulate.

5. Options: You can experiment with advanced trading strategies using options, both for hedging and for speculation. Options are financial derivatives that give the holder the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a particular share at a predetermined price within a specified maturity date. It is possible to hold a maximum of 10% of the share capital.

6. Short selling: is a trading strategy in which an investor sells a security that he does not actually own at the time of sale. The objective is to profit from the previewed decrease of the price of the stock in the time. You can short out 20% of a company’s share capital.

Get ready for a realistic and engaging experience in the world of finance and trading. Stay tuned for more details on the game launch!

notes.title: #1 Develop Update
notes.content:
Hi guys,

finally the trailer of Hedge Fund Tycoon is out and the development proceeds at a good pace.
The purpose of this article is to keep you updated on the development and add new information about the gameplay. 
This article will be followed by others. Each of them will deepen an aspect of the game.

Description of the game

Hedge Fund Tycoon, the game that allows you to enter the fascinating and competitive world of finance, multinationals and politics. In this unique simulator, you will step into the shoes of a powerful hedge fund manager with complete control of your financial empire.

Main features

Advanced Financial Management: In Hedge Fund Tycoon, you can trade with various financial products, including stocks, bonds, government bonds, commodities, and options. Make wise and strategic investment decisions to grow your portfolio and make profits.

Company management: Acquire and manage companies, make decisions about their management, open and close branches around the world, and plan financial operations such as mergers and acquisitions. Your entrepreneurial cunning is the key to success.

Political Influence: Interact with political parties and governments to achieve your goals. Fund parties to gain support and influence political decisions in your favor, or even bribe officials to get laws that favor you.

Customization: Customize your fund and your business management style. Choose from which country to start and your way in business and finance.


Objective of the game

The game gives the player complete freedom to pursue the goal. Become the richest hedge fund? Create a monopoly in the Oil & Drilling industry? Your choice! No end game

When it will be published
The goal is to publish the game on 8th January 2024

We hope we have piqued your imagination; if you have any questions or suggestions please let us know!
